name: non-uniform damage
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 不同位置或构件损伤程度不一致的状态。

complete_examples.text: The results show that the dynamic responses of the train and track system significantly exacerbate as the number of train cycles increases, which is closely related to the variability and non-uniform damage of the fasteners.
It indicates that non-uniform damage of fasteners will significantly increase the dynamic interaction between the train and the foundation structure.
